intro.title: LemonDouble
intro.body: I'm a developer who loves building fun things. From the servers in my home to a keyboard I designed myself, here's what I've made so far.

voice.title: Giving machines a voice
voice.body: I polished a Japanese TTS library to make it easier to use. With that voice, the speakers in my home can now talk.

homelab.title: A tiny datacenter at home
homelab.body: I run a K3S cluster on a mini PC and a GPU workstation. Photo backups, local LLMs, a search server and even a social network all run on it.

iot.title: Running my home with code
iot.body: When a device has no official integration, I write one. Power bills, maps and the morning weather briefing are all managed in Home Assistant.

hardware.title: Things you can touch
hardware.body: I design the circuits and PCBs myself and 3D print the cases. I finished a wireless macropad, and I've also built a weapon from a game.

agents.title: Working alongside AI agents
agents.body: I spend a lot of time working with Claude Code. I built a dashboard to see usage at a glance, and a design system that helps agents produce consistent designs.

contact.title: Feel free to reach out
contact.body: You can find all my projects and the tools I use on my blog via '{projects}' in the top right. If you have any questions, reach me on any channel below.

projects.hayakoe: A Japanese TTS library polished to be easy to use
projects.lemon-tts: A Home Assistant integration that speaks Japanese from any input language
projects.lemon-k8s-cluster: A K3S homelab cluster on a mini PC and a GPU workstation
projects.misskey: A microblogging social network instance I run myself
projects.misskey-geeknews-webhooks: A bot that auto-posts new GeekNews articles to Misskey
projects.kepco-powerplanner-ha-addon: An add-on that brings KEPCO PowerPlanner electricity usage into Home Assistant
projects.hass-kakao-map-changer: An integration that swaps the Home Assistant map for Kakao Map
projects.shiroko: A weather briefing app shown on the TV every morning
projects.geardrak: A 16-key wireless macropad I built myself, from circuit to case
projects.supernova: A 3D-printed display prop of Aris's Supernova from Blue Archive
projects.claude-dashboard: A web dashboard that shows Claude Code usage at a glance
projects.lemon-design-system: A personal design system that helps AI agents produce consistent designs
